dosage_frequency: every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain relief || once daily for chronic conditions
mechanism_of_action: binds weakly to mu-opioid receptors, found in the spinal cord and brain; produces inhibitory effects by targeting neurotransmitters, norepinephrine and serotonin
side_effects: nausea, vomiting, dizziness, constipation, dry mouth, sweating, confusion, drowsiness, agitation, seizures, allergic reactions
unsuitable_population: elderly, patients with liver or kidney impairment, pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers
